summary: Separate wrapped cell images from one conditionally reconstructed continuous path in a fixed orthorhombic cell.
objective: Build a periodic-trajectory inspector that compares wrapped and temporally unwrapped coordinates, exposes image counters, and rejects ambiguous undersampled crossings.
intent_signals: show wrapped versus continuous particle path
example_prompts: Unwrap a molecule crossing a fixed orthorhombic box, show image counters, and flag a frame jump at exactly half a box.
negative_signals: Not a triclinic or changing-cell algorithm, integrator, diffusion calculation or guarantee that undersampled motion is recoverable.
not_for: No time-varying cell, triclinic lattice, missing sequential frames, ambiguous half-box displacement, bond-changing trajectory or physical-property calculation.

entities.name: Wrapped cell and replicas
entities.guidance: Blender constructs a precise orthorhombic cell cage, translucent neighboring images and atom glyphs. Three.js owns wrapped positions, image counters and derived unwrapped positions.

entities.name: Continuity inspector
entities.guidance: Show component deltas, chosen integer image shift and assumption status for each sequential pair. Keep wrapped and unwrapped paths in linked views rather than overwriting source coordinates.

state_contract.model: Fixed orthorhombic cell lengths Lx,Ly,Lz>0 and strictly sequential frames with wrapped coordinates in [0,Lj). Initialize u0=w0 unless explicit source-provided integer image counters define u0=w0+n0L. Applicability requires a credible producer/sampling bound that each true per-frame component displacement is strictly less than Lj/2; wrapped deltas alone cannot establish this bound. For each tracked particle and axis j, d=w_i-w_(i-1); reject an exact half-box tie within declared tolerance, set d*=d-Lj*round(d/Lj), update the integer image counter consistently, and u_i=u_(i-1)+d*. Without the displacement bound, mark reconstruction unavailable rather than infer undersampling. Optional molecule-whole mode requires fixed supplied bonds and an anchor: make each frame whole through a declared spanning tree under a compatible minimum-image bound, verify non-tree bond closure, then temporally unwrap the anchor and apply its image shift to the whole group.
state_contract.authority: Source wrapped coordinates remain immutable. Three.js owns the declared reconstruction, ambiguity flags and dual views; Blender supplies cell/replica geometry only.
actions: Step sequentially and inspect wrapped delta, chosen image shift and unwrapped coordinate.
Toggle source-wrapped, per-particle continuity and validated molecule-whole views without changing data.
Load an exact-half-box fixture or remove the producer displacement guarantee and preserve ambiguity/unavailable status rather than guessing.
Reset clears derived counters/paths and returns to source frame zero.

invariants: Unwrapped coordinates rewrap to the source wrapped coordinate modulo each fixed box length within input tolerance.

The reconstruction requires an independently credible strict less-than-half-box component-displacement bound between stored frames; wrapped endpoints cannot reveal a hidden larger displacement, and an exact half-box delta is ambiguous.
Per-particle continuity does not guarantee a whole molecule. Molecule-whole mode requires fixed topology, a declared anchor/tree and cycle-closure checks.
Frame skipping, reordering or cell-length change invalidates accumulated image counters.
motion_guidance: Step commits one source frame or declared transformation; pause preserves committed state and reset restores data, view, selections and errors.
Offer a static frame/table alternative. Tweened atom, curve or surface motion explains correspondence only and never creates scientific samples.
creative_affordances: Blender may establish a distinctive molecular stage, lattice frame and stable atom/orbital glyph families; Three.js binds them to scientific IDs and data.
Materials, camera and composition remain flexible when units, provenance, sign, identity and uncertainty stay legible without color alone.
known_limits: Fixed orthorhombic box only. u0 defaults to the first wrapped image unless source image counters are supplied. Undersampling beyond half a box cannot be detected from wrapped endpoints alone; without a credible bound reconstruction is unavailable, and no diffusion or dynamical correctness is claimed.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no chemistry calculation, trajectory conversion, Blender export, browser, renderer or interactive artifact was run.

physical_contract.scope: Scientific coordinates and annotations drive display; mesh contact and animation do not compute chemistry.

object_craft.structure: Build one exact cell cage with ghost replicas and two synchronized path rails; image-counter tiles should stay attached to semantic atom IDs, not transient mesh order.
object_craft.material: Use solid source positions and patterned derived images; mark ambiguity with a stop glyph and text, never a smoothed guess.

claims.statement: Periodic simulations commonly store coordinates wrapped into a unit cell, while analyses such as mean-square displacement may require continuous unwrapped trajectories; published work documents artifacts when unwrapping does not handle its cell assumptions correctly.
claims.scope: Motivation and limitations from Kulke and Vermaas; this recipe deliberately specializes to a fixed orthorhombic cell instead of implementing their changing-cell algorithm.

source_refs.locator: Abstract and Introduction: wrapped origin-cell output, continuous trajectories, uses and artifacts under changing boxes
